Key flat on a card (85.60 × 53.98 mm), shoulder and cuts visible. Use Rotate/Mirror/Flip to orient the key roughly level, bow to one side.

Auto-finds the card and drops a box on it; nudge any corner if it's off (85.60 × 53.98 mm). Scale updates live as you drag.

  • Blue = shoulder: drag onto the shoulder stop. Stays square to the back.
  • Green = back edge: drag its two ends onto the blade's straight back (depth zero).
  • Red line per cut: drag into the valley — left/right onto the cut, up/down to its floor.

Red = height matches a depth cleanly. Orange = between two depths — nudge until it turns red.

Scroll to zoom, drag an empty area to pan — for precise placement.

Pick the matching blank up top first (e.g. BEST-A for a BEST A / DORMA key) so the right number of cuts appears.

Printed keys are fragile — print on-edge in PETG/nylon/resin, treat as an emergency spare. Copy only keys you're authorized to duplicate.
